caption:
Phishing emails try to rush you. ⚠️ Check these 3 things:

1. Sender address matches the real company
2. Urgent threats or deadlines
3. Unexpected links or attachments

Not sure? Go to the website yourself, don't click. 📌 Save this.

Follow @techmendly for a new tech tip every day.

#cybersecurity #phishing #onlinesafety #scamalert #emailsecurity #staysafeonline #privacy #infosec #techtips #techmendly

scenes.text: This email says act now or lose your account.
scenes.say: This email says act now or lose your account. Stop. Check three things.

scenes.title: 3 signs of phishing
scenes.say: One, an odd sender address. Two, pressure and threats. Three, unexpected links or files.
Look closely at the sender address. Extra words or a different ending are a warning sign.

scenes.title: Skip the link
scenes.say: The safe move? Do not click. Open the official website yourself and sign in there.

scenes.say: If you are unsure, pause. Real companies can wait a minute while you check.
